About these 3 rides

They ride on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays. Starts run from 7:00 am to 5:30 pm. After work, 2 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 2 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 1. All 3 are road rides. Each one was checked at its source on Oct 1, 2026.
